Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Stinger is S on InfinityBuilds' endgame list ('Kopelek - Sting', updated September 16, 2026) [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list - 2026-09-16] and S on both Maxroll lists [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16], but only B on d4builds, which lists it first of its two B Spiritborn builds [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16] - the main disagreement. Endgame layout follows d4builds' 'Stinger - Spiritborn (S15)' (updated September 14, 2026) [https://d4builds.gg/builds/stinger-spiritborn-endgame/ - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/477b9bf6-c526-47ee-9b43-9c92c2aefd38 - 2026-09-16]: Rod of Kepeleke, Hesha e Kesungi, Ring of the Midnight Sun, Ring of Starless Skies, Harmony of Ebewaka, 5-piece Berú of the Multitude + Protean Heart, Stinger: Unleash the Swarm. Disagreements: Maxroll uses Potent Sting, Counterattack instead of Armored Hide on the bar, Tibault's Will, Aspect of Debilitating Toxins chest, Aspect of Rallying Reversal boots and Start > Prodigy's Tempo > Viscous Shield > Convergence > In-Fighter (Talon/Canny/Spirit/Colossal/Fester) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/stinger-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16]; InfinityBuilds uses Leoric's Crown and Aspect of Glynn's Anvil and Start > Convergence > Bitter Medicine > Prodigy's Tempo > Revealing [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/builds/_6EfxV8ono - 2026-09-16]. d4builds' notes mention 'Rezokas Rage talisman set and Aspect of Plains Power' although its charms are Berú of the Multitude - text copied from its Quill Volley page; the charm list is used. Maxroll's guide text 'Tzic is currently bugged...' and 'Aspect of Supremacy actually can stack up to 30 stacks' is out of date: 3.2.1 fixed Tzic and capped Supremacy at 15 [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394/celebrate-30-years-of-diablo-in-season-of-hell-s-legacy - 2026-09-16].

Rotation
  1. Keep Armored Hide, Toxic Skin, Ravager and Scourge running, cast The Protector on cooldown, and spam Stinger so every cast at full Vigor crits and Ring of the Midnight Sun refills it; if Vigor runs dry, run briefly or recast The Protector for Tibault's-style refills.
  2. For pushing, switch to Nimbostratal Strike and fight inside your Spirit Storms.
Variants

Leveling — The 'Poison Bomb' combo: 'Poison nearby enemies with Withering Fist, Scourge, and/or Toxic Skin; Slam Stinger until you're out of resource (Vigor); Repeat spamming Withering Fist to refill your resource' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/stinger-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Move to Midgame only when you own both Rod of Kepeleke and Ring of the Midnight Sun plus Harmony of Ebewaka - 'Don't use one without the other'.

Early Endgame — Maxroll Endgame rotation: 'Cast The Protector, Toxic Skin, Scourge, & Ravager; Cast both charges of Counterattack; spam Stinger' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/stinger-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Swap to the d4builds layout when your Ring of the Midnight Sun and Rod of Kepeleke are Mythic and you reach the Vigor breakpoint: Resource Generation of (100% / your Midnight Sun roll) - 100%, i.e. 100% at a 50% roll.

Late Endgame — d4builds: 'Maintain Armored Hide, Toxic Skin, Ravager, and Scourge; Cast The Protector on CD; Spam Stinger.' [https://d4builds.gg/builds/stinger-spiritborn-endgame/ - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/477b9bf6-c526-47ee-9b43-9c92c2aefd38 - 2026-09-16]
Move on when Go to Storms Push for Pit/Tower once Seal of the Golden Epiphany drops (three unique charms) and you have gear with Lightning Damage transfigurations - Maxroll: 'Top Push requires Gear swap'.

Pushing — 'Each cast of Stinger creates a Spirit Storm, up to three of them, AND makes each Spirit Storm echo a critical strike'; enemies 'need to be within an active Spirit Storm or directly hit by Stinger'; 'The Devourer Lightning Storm is NOT a Spirit Storm' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/stinger-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].

Stat requirements
  • Minimum Resource Generation: 100% + Ring of the Midnight Sun @ 50% - adjust to always recover 100% of your Vigor (d4builds)
  • Resource Generation needed = (100% / Ring of the Midnight Sun roll) - 100%: 47% roll 112.77%, 48% 108.33%, 49% 104.08%, 50% 100% (Maxroll)

How to run them

Maxroll Endgame (d4builds' tab is an unfilled template: default Subo 'Seeker' with Varyana 'Bloodthirst'): 'Subo for his map hacks & increased damage from Opening Fire and movement speed from Ready At Hand' and 'Aldakin's Field of Languish as reinforcement for additional DR'; Storms Push uses Raheir's Bastion on crowd control ('get out of jail free') [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/stinger-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16]. InfinityBuilds Staff Stinger: Subo + Raheir [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/builds/_6EfxV8ono - 2026-09-16].

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Stinger is S on InfinityBuilds' endgame list ('Kopelek - Sting', updated September 16, 2026) [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list - 2026-09-16] and S on both Maxroll lists [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16], but only B on d4builds, which lists it first of its two B Spiritborn builds [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16] - the main disagreement. Endgame layout follows d4builds' 'Stinger - Spiritborn (S15)' (updated September 14, 2026) [https://d4builds.gg/builds/stinger-spiritborn-endgame/ - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/477b9bf6-c526-47ee-9b43-9c92c2aefd38 - 2026-09-16]: Rod of Kepeleke, Hesha e Kesungi, Ring of the Midnight Sun, Ring of Starless Skies, Harmony of Ebewaka, 5-piece Berú of the Multitude + Protean Heart, Stinger: Unleash the Swarm. Disagreements: Maxroll uses Potent Sting, Counterattack instead of Armored Hide on the bar, Tibault's Will, Aspect of Debilitating Toxins chest, Aspect of Rallying Reversal boots and Start > Prodigy's Tempo > Viscous Shield > Convergence > In-Fighter (Talon/Canny/Spirit/Colossal/Fester) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/stinger-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16]; InfinityBuilds uses Leoric's Crown and Aspect of Glynn's Anvil and Start > Convergence > Bitter Medicine > Prodigy's Tempo > Revealing [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/builds/_6EfxV8ono - 2026-09-16]. d4builds' notes mention 'Rezokas Rage talisman set and Aspect of Plains Power' although its charms are Berú of the Multitude - text copied from its Quill Volley page; the charm list is used. Maxroll's guide text 'Tzic is currently bugged...' and 'Aspect of Supremacy actually can stack up to 30 stacks' is out of date: 3.2.1 fixed Tzic and capped Supremacy at 15 [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394/celebrate-30-years-of-diablo-in-season-of-hell-s-legacy - 2026-09-16].

Rotation
  1. Keep Armored Hide, Toxic Skin, Ravager and Scourge running, cast The Protector on cooldown, and spam Stinger so every cast at full Vigor crits and Ring of the Midnight Sun refills it; if Vigor runs dry, run briefly or recast The Protector for Tibault's-style refills.
  2. For pushing, switch to Nimbostratal Strike and fight inside your Spirit Storms.
Variants

Leveling — The 'Poison Bomb' combo: 'Poison nearby enemies with Withering Fist, Scourge, and/or Toxic Skin; Slam Stinger until you're out of resource (Vigor); Repeat spamming Withering Fist to refill your resource' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/stinger-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Move to Midgame only when you own both Rod of Kepeleke and Ring of the Midnight Sun plus Harmony of Ebewaka - 'Don't use one without the other'.

Early Endgame — Maxroll Endgame rotation: 'Cast The Protector, Toxic Skin, Scourge, & Ravager; Cast both charges of Counterattack; spam Stinger' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/stinger-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Swap to the d4builds layout when your Ring of the Midnight Sun and Rod of Kepeleke are Mythic and you reach the Vigor breakpoint: Resource Generation of (100% / your Midnight Sun roll) - 100%, i.e. 100% at a 50% roll.

Late Endgame — d4builds: 'Maintain Armored Hide, Toxic Skin, Ravager, and Scourge; Cast The Protector on CD; Spam Stinger.' [https://d4builds.gg/builds/stinger-spiritborn-endgame/ - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/477b9bf6-c526-47ee-9b43-9c92c2aefd38 - 2026-09-16]
Move on when Go to Storms Push for Pit/Tower once Seal of the Golden Epiphany drops (three unique charms) and you have gear with Lightning Damage transfigurations - Maxroll: 'Top Push requires Gear swap'.

Pushing — 'Each cast of Stinger creates a Spirit Storm, up to three of them, AND makes each Spirit Storm echo a critical strike'; enemies 'need to be within an active Spirit Storm or directly hit by Stinger'; 'The Devourer Lightning Storm is NOT a Spirit Storm' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/stinger-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].

Stat requirements
  • Minimum Resource Generation: 100% + Ring of the Midnight Sun @ 50% - adjust to always recover 100% of your Vigor (d4builds)
  • Resource Generation needed = (100% / Ring of the Midnight Sun roll) - 100%: 47% roll 112.77%, 48% 108.33%, 49% 104.08%, 50% 100% (Maxroll)

Reasoning

Based onPestilent Swarm Spiritborn
Tweaks vs. the base build
  1. Stinger replaces Counterattack of the Swarm as the damage: Rod of Kepeleke makes Core Skills cast at maximum Vigor critical strikes ('All of your hits are critical strikes due to Rod of Kepeleke' [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/stinger-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16]), and 3.2.1 buffs Stinger 115% to 140% while halving Counterattack of the Swarm (150% to 75%) [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394/celebrate-30-years-of-diablo-in-season-of-hell-s-legacy - 2026-09-16].
  2. Stinger: Unleash the Swarm ('Stinger spawns 3 Pestilent Swarms that deal 100% damage') at late endgame - the upgrade both d4builds and InfinityBuilds take [https://d4builds.gg/builds/stinger-spiritborn-endgame/ - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/477b9bf6-c526-47ee-9b43-9c92c2aefd38 - 2026-09-16] [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/builds/_6EfxV8ono - 2026-09-16]; Maxroll's leveling/midgame/endgame use Potent Sting instead (disagreement) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/stinger-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].
  3. The Protector replaces The Devourer and Armored Hide replaces Rushing Claw on the late-endgame bar (d4builds): no mobility skill, Resolve/Unstoppable from The Protector instead of evade speed [https://d4builds.gg/builds/stinger-spiritborn-endgame/ - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/477b9bf6-c526-47ee-9b43-9c92c2aefd38 - 2026-09-16].
  4. Keeps the meta's shell: Harmony of Ebewaka helm, Aspect of Supremacy amulet, Ravager: Flurry of Claws / Toxic Skin: Skuttle Bug / Scourge, Prodigy's Tempo and Convergence boards [https://d4builds.gg/builds/stinger-spiritborn-endgame/ - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/477b9bf6-c526-47ee-9b43-9c92c2aefd38 - 2026-09-16].
  5. Resource instead of cooldown gearing: refill 100% Vigor every attack with Ring of the Midnight Sun, so Resource Generation and Resource Cost Reduction replace the meta's Cooldown Reduction rolls [https://d4builds.gg/builds/stinger-spiritborn-endgame/ - 2026-09-16] [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/477b9bf6-c526-47ee-9b43-9c92c2aefd38 - 2026-09-16].
  6. Talisman swaps Balazan's Bite for 5-piece Berú of the Multitude + Protean Heart ('a 4th Spirit Tag... further increases your damage from the set & from Harmony of Ebewaka') [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/stinger-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].
  7. Pushing switches Stinger to Nimbostratal Strike and adds the Swarm of Storms board (Maxroll 'Storms Push': 'Most Likely Top Push for Season') [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/stinger-spiritborn-guide - 2026-09-16].

Rod of Kepeleke

Unique Quarterstaff
